fusions.name: Barbed Spur
fusions.desc: A kick with a barbed spur that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Long-Haul Swarm
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stingers at once, spread apart, each dealing 14 damage and ignoring armour. Their damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 36%.

fusions.name: Waggle Dance
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles deals 15% more damage and gains 1 Power for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Dawn to Dusk
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs dry, you regain 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
